title: Guide or recover the first publisher who integrates before bootstrap confirmation
outcome: Guide or recover the first publisher who integrates before bootstrap confirmation
acceptance: The first-publisher workflow explicitly says to commit the exact bootstrap export and run ordinary import to confirm it before fetching or merging other hosts' commits, or ordinary import itself confirms an exact own commit found on HEAD ancestry with a constant number of Git launches
A bootstrap committed exactly and then fast-forwarded to another host's child either follows the printed guidance or imports and confirms the delta without a saved-basis refusal
Any code path refuses inexact ancestry or postimages and introduces no unbounded history walk, per-file launch or new gate
